about: Mess kinds, liquid classes, strictness order and densities of the house ledger's mess balance (VERIFY_HARDENING 6.5, 6.11; WP1). kinds: the kernel defaults of each registered kind (@mess_kind in kernel/plugins.py; a registration's own unit, sinks, eps or rho win): unit, the accepting sink classes (location_classes.json; 'outside' and 'drain' name the location-key classes), eps (absolute tolerance in the unit), rho (relative slack of the unaccounted balance) and the origin class its parcels carry when the measure names none. A registered kind with no entry here needs all four in its registration. strictness: an origin group is judged by the strictest class among its members (first = strictest). food_contact_rho: rho of a group whose source or destination is food contact. kg_per_unit: the kilogram equivalent of one unit of the kind (liquids by density) for the cross-kind total; total_eps_kg and total_rho: its tolerances.
